links.outcome: Gold standard annotations by clinicians used to evaluate proofreading and extraction
links.effect: Annotations by a team of doctors and nurses provided the gold standard; fine-tuned model outperformed GPT-4o on both tasks; masked raters preferred model versions 62% of trials (p<0.001).
links.quote: Annotations by a team of doctors and nurses provided the gold standard.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning small open-source LLMs locally on consumer-grade servers for clinical note proofreading and information extraction
Masked human-preference evaluation of model-corrected versus human-corrected notes

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2 and GPT-4o) on retrospective EHR notes for proofreading and information extraction, including a blind human preference reader evaluation, but does not evaluate a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
